cumleler: Can a room that is great for music be bad for speech?
Reverberation time: how long sound takes to drop sixty decibels after stopping.
In a treated classroom, it is about half a second.
Concert halls aim for about two seconds, so music sounds full.
In large places of worship, it can reach several seconds.
With long reverberation, strong vowel tails mask weak consonants.
